method: Read-only current source and maintained-test reconciliation; retained evidence separately attributed; no new executable tests or native acceptance

findings.disposition: Ordinary existing .tex header rename now takes the shared lease hold, but still bypasses the registered LaTeX view-participant preflight. The in-place route is restricted to Markdown or newly started TeX. Durable rename intent now protects transport identity, but does not settle another view's IME/math/form input. Route every TeX rename through all actual owners; test two views.

The bibliography source has a lease, but an unfinished reference form remains in referenceDrafts and does not register pending input/rename readiness on the actual .bib owner. Protect that target, not just the currently displayed .tex; test a dirty form and rename from a second view.

Parked recovery still reads a JSON array and rewrites it in localStorage. No transaction across windows protects concurrent additions/removals. Move this supported multi-writer operation to atomic storage and retain every foreign entry.

flushVisualDraft still compares a read slot with an observed value, then performs a separate setLocalStorageItem. Equality detects some conflicts but is not compare-and-swap across windows. Preserve both contenders atomically.
The field journal still performs read/compare/write or read/compare/remove on localStorage. Its ownership check can race. Use an atomic owner-scoped journal, with two-window interleaving tests.

The storage warning resets on a matching save with no pending work, but the discard/undo-to-clean branch only discards ownDraft. Clear the warning after verified retirement of that owner's record; retain it if cleanup fails.

Included-file ProjectFileSession confirms drafts on saves, while project acceptance still checkpoints them separately. It lacks the selected-file recovery hook's pagehide/cleanup flush. Durable publication intents reduce accepted-save loss but do not cover this separate local checkpoint; consolidate the writer/exit path.

Every build now gets a fresh private attempt directory. Cancellation/finalizers cannot delete a successor's output; an uncertain cancellation retains only that attempt. Maintained tests cover delayed fetch, precompile hashing, delayed cleanup and restart. Keep this isolation; do not restore the global whole-descendant admission regression.

Drawing preview starts off and requires explicit source-bound execute-host-tex admission; source changes revoke it. The UI discloses host filesystem authority. This closes automatic-on-mount execution, not sandboxing or hermetic TeX execution.

The old whole-workspace/.git walk has been replaced by recorder/tracked-input and candidate-search validation. Dynamic/default/recursive paths conservatively force the driver. The specific workspace-size cache defect is superseded; ordinary preview throughput still needs measurement.

The obsolete universal XeLaTeX refusal is replaced by positive explicit XeLaTeX/latexmk coverage and correct missing-provider refusal. Optional installed LuaLaTeX preserves default Tectonic. These maintained tests are inspected, not newly run here.

Build descriptor binding/freshness now feeds visible Rebuild required/update state. Last-good PDF remains readable during failed or pending rebuilds. Earlier actual desktop evidence is bounded to its tested snapshot; final-head all-mode acceptance remains separate.

Retained-reader failure/status and retry controls exist without discarding the last-good reader. Check both update failure and initial authorization failure at the pinned head; do not call a retained old PDF fresh.

Forward navigation checks compiled source identity, pending edits and a current descriptor; server metadata binds the immutable revision to sourceRevisions and revalidates before/after queries. Changed revisions invalidate pending reveals. Maintain direct-RPC stale/ABA and delayed reveal tests.

latexSelectionClipboard marks math/table content as structured, but a selection containing only ref/cite/href-style inline command atoms takes textBetween. Atom content can still disappear. Add atom-aware serialization and copy/paste consumer tests.

Lossless list serialization now emits owned item patches; repeated live-item ownership repairs preserve untouched siblings instead of canonicalizing the whole list. Keep byte-exact sibling/CRLF/comment and repeated-item undo fixtures; this is not arbitrary-list round-trip certification.

Nested layout/scientific projection callbacks still pass allowRootUpdates:false. A requirement accepted at the root can be refused inside a container. Propagate required setup through an explicit owned plan; preserve two-physical-file refusal until grouped acceptance exists.

External source installation still calls projectLatexVisualDocument synchronously in the mounted editor effect before replacing state. Initial opening/worker improvements do not remove this separate large-source update path. Fence and move projection off the UI thread; measure external updates independently.

The pagination anchor now falls back to captureLatexViewportAnchor when a focused caret lies outside the viewport. The old no-anchor branch is gone. Native momentum/IME acceptance remains a qualification item.

Compact paragraph snapshots, changed-block measurement, reusable geometry and coalesced page fences substantially reduce repeated preparation work. Full fallback pagination still exists. Establish production editing/Enter/frame-tail cost before claiming all cohorts are incremental.

onTransaction excludes pagination metadata and ordinary typed documents, but does not exclude viewport-only presentation transactions before refreshToolbar. Add explicit transaction taxonomy and verify scrolling does not trigger semantic toolbar work.

latexViewportPageNodes now builds a cached page index, but thumbnail admission presentLatexViewportPages still nests every unit over placements and scans members. The reading-page index does not repair that separate quadratic path. Reuse the index and measure thumbnail demand.

The viewport decorations path still creates a DecorationSet from all document units rather than mapping/reusing only changed decorations. Page readiness coalescing reduces frequency, not per-transaction full-set cost. Fix invalidation ownership before optimizing.

The table editing-guide module is unchanged from the reviewed revision. No current viewport/active-table gate closes the old offscreen measurement mechanism. Limit guide geometry to the active mounted table and qualify navigation/selection.

Viewport admission now retains a source-block anchor through spacer replacement and preparation. Latest repair also prevents retargeting to a newly visible predecessor and cancels same-top navigation settlement. Original 1px stress regression is reported passing; do not generalize it to all native scroll cases.

Template choice reads the title textarea globally, or entry.name for titleless templates; it does not read/flush the currently typed Document name input through its owner. Preserve pending name across switches and target the correct pane.

createNewDocumentSource still returns personal template source unchanged when English is selected. A Hebrew saved template is not converted by that branch. Define reversible supported language conversion with exact unrelated-byte preservation.

DEFAULT_HEBREW_DOCUMENT_FONT is still Times New Roman. Added font selection/layout repairs do not establish availability on supported Linux hosts. Use a qualified portable default or actionable explicit font admission; test real compilation on the target host.
scopesOverlap still treats table as disjoint from its LaTeX host. The catalogue is unchanged. Model actual table/host overlap and verify customization plus runtime dispatch.

The reader-control stylesheet is unchanged; the page-number focus selector still shares inappropriate sizing with zoom controls and lacks the requested visible focus treatment. Repair and inspect keyboard focus at normal/large scale.

Personal template preview capture is unchanged and has no canvas pixel materialization. Cloning a canvas node is not durable drawing content. Encode canvas output safely and verify a saved/reloaded preview.

Every changed Markdown doc still runs textBetween over the whole document and countWords in useMemo. No incremental word-count owner was added. Profile long Markdown typing, then cache/update by changed ranges if material.

Relocating away from a folder template still exempts every .bib companion from removal. Preserve shared/changed bibliographies, but clean the exact unchanged dedicated file created by this template under its revision guard.

focusNewDocumentWhenOpen still searches only rich Markdown/LaTeX contenteditable surfaces. Source-mode Markdown is absent. Focus the chosen editor through the surface command instead of a global DOM query.

The general empty-paragraph serializer emits \par, but the minimal plain-text patch can return an empty string first. Guidance still requires a paragraph's exact \par sentinel. Preserve it on clear/reopen/undo; the retained comment and generic fallback do not close guidance loss.

Owned patches carry physical occurrence/boundary identity; the project planner retains included-file EOF/empty-file ownership and repeated appearances. Tests cover physical destination, multi-block EOF, inverse patches and unchanged root. Keep two-file refusal; this is distinct from grouped editing.

The obsolete ignored rootUpdate prop channel is removed. Explicit LatexSourceEdit.root patches are validated and joined in the planner; same-physical-file root/body edits can succeed, two-file plans refuse. Do not restore a silently ignored setup side channel.

More consumers share latexSourceSyntax and bounded macro-definition masking now preserves document boundaries, including starred/trivia/unbraced declarations. Independent regex/raw-includes/comment paths remain. Differential qualification must include comments, verbatim, conditional declarations and macro bodies; consolidation is incomplete.

The unchanged-inline/nonText-signature fallback can accept a local text patch when general reprojection comparison fails. No new failing input is established here. Differential exact-source/projection tests should constrain it before broader grammar coverage.

Source-plan primitives are stronger, but admission, history, pending input and projection lifecycle still live substantially inside LatexVisualEditor. Extract a controller around existing contracts one operation at a time; do not create a second canonical document.

Source plan/outcome contracts and persistence failures now have explicit identities/reasons, but visual insertion/refusal presentation still uses generic string notices/null returns. Typed per-operation capability/refusal remains incomplete.

Two physical files are intentionally refused before working mutation. One-file root/body patches are now supported. Expand only with staged owner acceptance, per-file acknowledgement, build barriers and safe undo; no atomic disk-save promise.

Fresh attempt directories prevent attachment of a prior attempt's stale .bbl. Publication still attaches any bounded .bbl found in the successful attempt without proving that the final run consumed it. Add recorder-consumption proof for same-attempt failure/retry edges or narrow the displayed claim.

Fresh attempt isolation and generation/binding fences cover the earlier precompile hashing/cleanup extension of B1. Maintained delayed-hash/cleanup regressions exist. This is part of B1, not an extra blocker count.

Artwork no longer installs packages as a side effect and Tectonic previews are cache-only. The installer serializes mutation and retains an unknown outcome marker, with timeout/retirement tests. Shared explicit installs still use request-scoped process finalization; whole cross-request reader/install coordination is not established. Preserve the working trusted build lane and qualify cancellation separately.
A successful artwork response can still carry raster and base64 PDF fallback together. Measure allocation/transport cost before changing the fallback contract; this is not a demonstrated severe leak.

Preview algorithm numbering is supplied from the current projection and written into the private generated picture source. The old editable-workspace .aux read is absent. Validate numbering with actual artwork output.

Startup cleanup now examines bounded service-owned directories and checks marker/host/instance/settled retirement before deleting a proved orphan. Live/uncertain/unmarked directories remain. This is conservative cleanup, not a complete crash/storage-quota guarantee.

attachmentByteLength remains optional and no producer writes it; resolveRevisionForAsset still rereads metadata after resolveRevisionUnlocked. Attachment retention accounting and duplicate-read cleanup remain.

Build, artwork and installer jobs share more lifetime helpers but still duplicate driver/process/environment/output logic. Extract only a common owned-job substrate; keep publication and explicit artwork authority distinct.
Project/root discovery remains spread between build service/index/document-resolution paths. Truthful root error/Retry is improved; one resolver and diagnostic contract are still a follow-up.

Receipt/hash/recorder requalification costs still need matched real-engine measurements. Fresh attempt isolation intentionally changes incremental-build reuse. Measure cold, repeated and recorder-expanded inputs before optimizing away evidence checks.

Server SyncTeX metadata and consumers now bind sourceRevisions plus immutable PDF revision/evidence basename and validate around navigation. This is no longer only a UI defense proposal. Retain direct-RPC stale/ABA tests.

Workspace/source evidence is observational and scoped; distribution, fonts, ambient search paths and network are not an immutable hermetic job snapshot. Disclose that boundary. Receipt v2/reproducibility is a separate capability.

LatexTikzPreview now has maintained unit coverage for authority admission, missing provider/cached resources, private outputs and unretired installation refusal. These inspected tests do not establish an OS sandbox.
The comment saying evidence earns exactly one rebuild remains, while status reads do not consume requalification. Align the comment with actual start/status behavior; no behavior rewrite is needed.
compiledBibliography remains in build/status snapshots, bounded at roughly 1 MB. Revision attachments/presentation queries could avoid repeated poll payloads. Measure cost before API migration.

Open now reads IndexedDB checkpoints for every format, restores held publication/attention and can reconcile old draft bytes even when ordinary TeX draft retention is disabled. The old blanket orphan claim is superseded. Add an exact released .tex checkpoint migration/clean-retirement fixture before declaring upgrade coverage complete.

Durable accepted save/rename intents now use the transactional checkpoint lane, but live visual drafts, fields and parked recovery still use independent non-atomic localStorage operations. This overlaps R3/R4/R5; do not count it as a fourth independent loss defect.

Durable namespace intents and recovery-attention handling are added; the new-document in-place route checks old/new path leftovers. Ordinary existing TeX rename still bypasses that full recovery namespace preflight. Close source and destination ownership together with R1.

Included-file draft retirement still follows matching save notification rather than all clean transitions; undo/discard-to-disk can leave the separate checkpoint. Consolidate with R7 and test clean return without publication.

Leases now own exact publication intents and attention, but unconverted LaTeX input still uses the separate procedural registry/view refs; reference forms are another store. Unify readiness via owner-scoped holds that permit the owner's own converted publication.

Raw session and production coordinator version semantics are distinct. Production clean external adoption advances edit identity. Preserve this intentional distinction; no additional version-counter defect is established.

Persistence outcomes gained typed attention/review identities, but recovery UI notices still mix storage, invalid input and operation strings. Typed presentation should follow actual outcome contracts rather than add another store.

Editor-side checkpointVisualDraft calls remain alongside the selected-file hook and can use sourceRevision.current from props. Acknowledgement-before-render can produce mismatched retirement identity. Use one lease-snapshot writer per file and retain project-only ownership explicitly.

The coordinator still has interacting mutable state fields, now including exact intent/review state. A state representation cleanup can follow meaningful transition coverage. Do not replace proven acknowledgement semantics for stylistic reasons.

Mounted external-source replacement still creates a fresh EditorState with the existing plugin list to clear history. That resets plugin state/lifetimes beyond undo. Use a history-scoped boundary or verified controlled replacement and test preview/viewport teardown.

Reference state still includes positions, and viewport context serializes that structure. Position-only edits can invalidate otherwise equivalent layout/render context. Separate semantic values from positions and test edits before many references.

Cancelling the active shared visual-processing job still stops the worker and restarts its generation. Generation fences prevent stale publication, but burst cancellation can lose warm work. Measure queue fairness and cold-start cost before changing cancellation policy.

Typing/source-clock and React presentation state are still coupled. Recent paragraph measurement/cache improvements do not quantify React work per native input. Profile the current production editing path and preserve save-clock/composition semantics.
Render-time writes to operational refs such as editBlocked remain. An extracted controller/committed callback boundary can reduce this coupling. No new concurrent-render failure was reproduced here.

Pending fences are now coalesced and targeted to affected source-member pages; compatible warm entry avoids a preparation flash. Other geometry/math/presentation notifications still use separate event/string contracts. Keep this improvement and finish typed common presentation only where it removes actual duplicate work.

setLatexPaginationDimensions still dispatches without an equality guard, and several editor paths write dimensions. Snapshot/local measurement does not make redundant geometry updates impossible. Guard equal inputs and define one committed geometry identity.
A formal semantic/selection/pagination/viewport transaction taxonomy is still missing from the React controller. F3 is the concrete before-ship correction; broad controller extraction follows.

An unhosted reader/footer fallback remains alongside the production reader-host path. Keep it clearly scoped to supported standalone/test use, or give tests a host and remove duplication after checking consumers.

The footnote widget still reuses measured DOM rows and attaches action listeners inside toDOM. Duplicate-factory effects remain an inference. Make factories own rows/listeners and test repeated construction before asserting a user-visible bug.
Reference extraction and whole-document counts still run in acknowledgement/presentation-related paths. Measure and attribute them; no current-keypress millisecond claim is justified by old timings.

Passive formula previews and a bounded live-field pool remain intentional. Cache/page/readiness and accessibility work improve that design. Do not replace all passive nodes with interactive readOnly fields without measured consumer benefit.

Retained native publication binds expected revision/absence before work and retains competing actual entries, with bounded macOS regression evidence. The original overwrite implementation is replaced. Linux/Windows cannot satisfy the activated admission contract; final cross-platform success and durability are not closed (U1).

Root/parent/entry bindings and native containment checks replace the earlier path-check-then-stage seam; actual macOS symlink/relocation cases are covered by retained evidence. No universal filesystem/platform containment claim follows. Keep unsupported-host refusal visible while restoring supported-host availability.

Native retained rename/exchange/compensation replaces the old vulnerable check/unlink sequence and binds exact replay to the original mutation identity. Bounded late-writer/entry tests exist on macOS. Qualify positive rename/recovery on every supported host; do not relabel refusal as successful rename.

Meaningful owned-source, replay, cancellation, native and Chromium tests now supplement source-text seam assertions. Some implementation-spelling tests remain. Migrate the remaining contract assertions without deleting useful regression coverage or calling aggregate partial suites a full gate.

Placement/file commands remain pure seams and durable mutations are stronger; the UI hook still owns global DOM lookup plus relocation/template orchestration. Fix S1/S8/S9 narrowly, then extract one owner-scoped command layer.

Canonical per-path lock-table retention/map work still merits bounded resource profiling. Native/journal locks now add cross-process ownership. A local semaphore eviction optimization must not weaken serialization or exact replay.
